name: [R10] AI workload hitting the cloud metadata credential endpoint
message:
A process tagged as agent/LLM-tool/code-interpreter requested a service-account credential path from the cloud metadata service. This is the mechanism behind Unit 42's "Double Agents" (GCP Vertex AI, 2026-03-31) and their CrewAI/AutoGen metadata-token-theft scenario — a tool inside the agent exfiltrates the workload's own service-agent token. Investigate: confirm the call came from an expected SDK path, not an agent-authored tool/script.

Tune: src_tag to however you tag hosts/containers running agent code; this fires on legitimate SDK calls too if that tagging is too broad.

queries.name: metadata_credential_access
queries.query: source:(proxy OR firewall) @network.destination.name:(169.254.169.254 OR metadata.google.internal OR metadata) @http.url_details.path:(*\/computeMetadata\/v1\/instance\/service-accounts\/* OR *\/latest\/meta-data\/iam\/security-credentials\/* OR *\/metadata\/identity\/oauth2\/token*) @network.client.tag:(agent OR llm-tool OR code-interpreter)

cases.name: Metadata credential endpoint accessed from agent workload
